shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin and Ethereum prices fell on Aug 11-12, leading a broad market risk-off move.
Spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $144.6M in net outflows on Aug 10, ending a 7-day inflow streak.
U.S. July CPI data (due Aug 12) is the week's key macro catalyst, driving market caution.
US-Iran negotiation deadlock and Strait of Hormuz uncertainty are elevating oil prices, weighing on risk appetite.
SEC plans "Regulation Crypto" rulemaking meeting Aug 14; Senator Gillibrand pushes a crypto ethics ban.
